arguments.assumptions: Explicit hypothetical FY2026 GAAP diluted-EPS/P-E sensitivity, not consensus, forecast, observed multiple, or fair-value estimate. FY26 first nine months reported GAAP diluted EPS is $41.40. Q4 GAAP EPS guidance is $30.73 +/- $1.00, making the residual annual bridge directly tied to guidance, subject to different quarterly diluted-share counts. Bear $69.00 assumes a low-end Q4 guide outcome and modest execution/mix pressure; base $72.13 mechanically combines nine-month EPS with the guided midpoint under a constant diluted-share approximation; bull $74.00 assumes high-end Q4 guidance and continued AI-memory demand/margin execution. Multiples 12x/14x/16x are deliberately unweighted stress assumptions.

cases.rationale: Low-end Q4 guided EPS with execution/mix pressure and multiple compression stress.
Nine-month reported EPS plus Q4 guided midpoint under a constant-share approximation; hypothetical multiple.
High-end Q4 guided EPS with continued AI-memory demand/margin execution and multiple expansion stress.
